item.title: 2.6 Million Pages of Assamese Literature Enter Digital Phase 2.0
item.description: In a landmark step towards preserving and modernising Assamese literature, Digitization 2.0 was formally launched today using royalty funds from Siang and Mautam (14th Edition) along with savings from earlier projects. item.title: Guwahati Woman Attempts Suicide By Jumping From Building, Hospitalized
